detail.longDescription:
Visual Code transforms your iPhone and iPad into a complete development environment. Built with performance, portability, and flexibility in mind, it allows you to write, debug, and run code wherever you are. Whether you’re a student, hobbyist, or professional developer, Visual Code gives you the power of a desktop IDE in a mobile-first design.

Powerful and Intuitive
Visual Code features a sleek, modern interface optimized for productivity. With syntax highlighting, intelligent formatting, and customizable themes, you can focus on what matters most: writing clean, efficient code.

Multi-Language Support
Work in the language of your choice without switching apps. Visual Code supports a wide range of popular programming languages, including: Python, JavaScript, C, C++, PHP, Java, Swift, HTML, CSS, Golang, Rust, Ruby, Objective-C, Perl, and Lua.

Built-In Terminal
Run commands directly inside the app with the integrated terminal. Manage projects, test scripts, and control workflows seamlessly without ever leaving Visual Code.
Optimized for iOS 26 and iPadOS

- Liquid Gas Design: Smooth, futuristic UI tailored to the latest iOS standards.
- Deep iPad Integration: Take advantage of multi-window support, multitasking, and full external keyboard compatibility.
- Keyboard Shortcuts: Streamline your workflow with shortcut support for iPad keyboards, making coding even faster.

Why Choose Visual Code?
- Work on the go with an all-in-one coding environment.
- Enjoy a familiar desktop-like experience with mobile convenience.
- Build, test, and refine projects without compromise.
